rationale: The Court is likely to adopt a Griggs-based jurisdictional-divestiture rule requiring a stay of merits proceedings during a non-frivolous FAA § 16(a) arbitrability appeal, while allowing truly collateral/status-quo measures and relying on sanctions or summary procedures to deter abuse. Sotomayor is the most likely dissenter, emphasizing Landis discretion and the absence of an express statutory stay.
